initial_plan_requirement: same-task, hard-task-valid, executable P0 with its fixed task-family refinement evaluation
evaluator: frozen V6 task-family evaluator and taxonomy; all applicable dimensions are recomputed after each submitted plan
feedback_scheduling: one highest-priority current gap only; no queued replay
feedback_grounding: current plan step IDs and observed links, positions, and field declarations; do not disclose a missing solution operation
same_plan_lineage: P0 -> P1 -> P2; each submitted revision records task, fixed goal, parent version, and complete plan
permitted_plan_revisions: any plan portion may change while remaining on the same task and fixed goal

shared_followup_limit.source: interaction-protocol-v3.0 shared initial-plus-five envelope, inherited pending successor-protocol approval
shared_followup_limit.counting: Agent-initiated post-P0 model calls; stop action also consumes one call

ordinary_terminal_rules.source: Existing frozen V6 micro-pilot and V6.2 capacity-sensitivity contracts
ordinary_terminal_rules.hard_task_failure: A submitted hard-invalid plan is retained and passively recorded, then the branch ends under the inherited ordinary hard-task terminal rule
ordinary_terminal_rules.all_refinements_satisfied: End immediately without another model call
ordinary_terminal_rules.autonomous_stop: End immediately and record the Agent-selected stop
ordinary_terminal_rules.shared_call_cap: End after the fifth post-P0 Agent-initiated model call

passive_audit: all applicable refinement statuses and transitions
per-dimension not-evaluable status after hard-task failure
post-P0 prompt/completion/total tokens, model calls, and wall time
substantive_refinement_rule: real evaluator-relevant plan change plus at least one fixed refinement-status improvement; simultaneous regression is counted separately
preflight_scope: deterministic mechanism invariance only; does not certify real State-checkpoint P0 eligibility
state_block_contract: task material and P0 may vary by State; model profile, taxonomy/runtime, and shared call cap remain common
